source: Nepse Decode derived sector indices (own OHLC archive); NEPSE from official index history
note: Monthly return = month-end close vs previous available month-end close. The in-progress month is excluded from the matrices; its historical behaviour is summarised in each matrix's forward block. Sector composites are reconstructions from constituent stocks, not official NEPSE sub-indices. NEPSE's own series is capped at the archive's latest session, so a stray index-history row past the archive cannot create a phantom month. forward_ledger tracks every this-month/next-month prediction from the first run that carries it: predicted sign recorded at first sight, resolved against the month's realized return once it closes.
